Square plate about 24 cm. On it:

- **Two pizza slices:** one cheese slice of about 12x7 cm (roughly 70 g) and one larger meat/bacon slice cut into two pieces (roughly 130 g). Together about 200 g of pizza at about 2.7 kcal/g, giving about 540 kcal.
- **Double chocolate cookie:** about 7 cm across, roughly 35 g, giving about 160 kcal.

Total: about 235 g and 700 kcal.
